handoffGoal: Capture the human confirmations required before any Java rollback window can be considered.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: artifact-version-target
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the exact jar or release tag selected for rollback.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: runtime-config-profile
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the runtime profile and configuration source for the target environment.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: configuration-secret-source
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms where secrets are managed outside this repository.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: production-secret-source-contract
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the read-only secret source contract used by the production environment checklist.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: database-migration-direction
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms whether migration state is forward-only, rollback-script-reviewed, or no-op.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: rollback-sql-review-gate
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the SQL review gate used before any rollback SQL can be considered.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: release-bundle-manifest
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the release bundle manifest used for the rollback window review.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: deployment-rollback-evidence
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the rollback boundary evidence used by the window review.

operatorResponsibilities: Confirm selected artifact version before any rollback window.
Confirm runtime configuration and secret source outside this sample.
Confirm production secret source contract without reading secret values.
Confirm database migration direction without executing rollback SQL from this sample.
Confirm Java rollback remains outside Node automated actions.
forbiddenOperations: Executing database rollback SQL from this handoff
Reading production secret values from this handoff
